The last field team left eleven years ago. The animals stayed. Sneak, sedate and sample them — or go loud, and answer for every carcass.

Vehicles

The stabilized trail bike waits at the inland end of the Supply Dock (BIKE on the map). It balances automatically and leans into turns. A humvee and a tank stand in the motor pool at Camp Halvorsen, on the north-east plateau; the tank's shells restock at the camp's ammo bunker. The sea lab's submersible hangs in the moon pool of the station off the west coast (SUB on the map): walk the pier out from the beach west of the Field Lab, or land on its roof.
